title: The model shelf got crowded
summary:
More models and a realtime voice API widened what people can build, while clearer docs, pricing details, and community apps made the growing toolkit easier to use.

New options covered grounded search, reasoning, vision, video, and embeddings. The additions included Grok 4.3, two Gemini Search models, Wan Pro video with audio, Cohere and Qwen embeddings, two StepFun models, Perplexity search options, and paid-only Claude Opus 4.8 with a 1M-token context window. Embedding requests now support up to 4096 dimensions, and six existing models became available with free Pollen.

An OpenAI-compatible `/v1/realtime` WebSocket endpoint was added for live text and audio input and output with `gpt-realtime-2`. Input transcription sessions are not supported yet.

Community additions ranged from image generation and remixable prompts to writing, web translation, chat, and Discord-based workflows. The catalog also received recurring metrics and listing cleanups; after six additions on May 30, the App Greenhouse count reached 791.

The API reference gained shared per-concept Markdown, BYOP, CLI, and MCP Server guides, page-aware copy controls, focused documentation slices, and JSON or YAML OpenAPI downloads. Model, video, embeddings, earnings, and Claude usage references were also updated alongside the corresponding changes.
